No. I-21016/13/2020-IPS III
भारत सरकार /Government of India
गृह मंत्रालय/Ministry of Home Affairs
Kartavya Bhavan 3, Janpath, New Delhi.
Dated, the 9th July, 2026

To
The Chief Secretary(s)
All State Governments
(Except Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, Mizoram & UTs)

Sub: Filling up the post of Joint Director earmarked for Indian Police Service (IPS) officers under Non-Central Staffing Scheme of the MoEF&CC in Wildlife Crime Control Bureau HQ, New Delhi in WCCB-reg.
I am directed to refer to the subject cited above and to say that Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change intends to fill up the below mentioned one post, on deputation basis:-

blocks.html:
Name of the postStationEquivalent to the postService for which earmarked
Joint Director, Level 13A in Pay Matrix of 7th CPCNew DelhiDeputy Inspector General of PoliceIndian Police Service

blocks.text: 2. It is, therefore, requested that aforesaid post may be given wider publicity and names of willing IPS officers of the rank of DIG may be forwarded to this Ministry at the earliest. While sending the nominations, it may please be ensured that the officers are clear from vigilance angle. The names should be reached this Ministry within a period of one month after issuance of this letter.

Yours faithfully,

(Sanjeev Kumar)
Under Secretary to the Govt. of India
E-mail : sanjeev.kumar43@nic.in
Tele: 011 24010120

Copy to:-

1. DsGP of all States (except Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, Mizoram & UTs)
2. Directors General/ Directors BSF/CRPF/ITBP/CISF/SSB/BPR&D/CBI/SPG/NIA/SVPNPA/NSG.
3. Intelligence Bureau (Smt. Rashmi Sinha, Additional Director), New Delhi.
4. Under Secretary (UTs-I), UTs Division, MHA for similar action in respect of AGMUT cadre officers.
5. Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change (Ms Sulagna Saha, US), 4th Floor, Block-3, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003- w.r.t their O.M. No. 8-9/2020-FE (E-140124) dated 22nd June, 2026.
6. Sr. Technical Director, NIC, MHA for uploading on MHA website. (IPS Portal under head - circulars).
